name: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd is primarily active in China's electronics market. Its diverse operations also encompass the provision of property and urban management services, alongside offering inspection, testing, and certification solutions. Additionally, the company is involved in both the development and ongoing management of photovoltaic (solar) power stations. Founded in 1996 and based in Shenzhen, China, Shenzhen SEG Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Shenzhen SEG Group Co., Ltd.
